title: Fluence Energy fiscal Q3 2026 earnings release
excerpt: Fluence reported fiscal Q3 revenue of USD 649.8 million, 5.1% GAAP gross margin, a USD 44.3 million net loss, USD 1.44 billion of order intake, USD 6.4 billion of backlog and USD 365.0 million of total cash.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release records the quarterly results, backlog, data-centre awards and reduced fiscal-2026 revenue and adjusted-EBITDA guidance that materially changed the baseline decision gates.
